## Context / Problem
Normal compaction (`src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py:522-654`), rebuild (`compact_rebuild.py:107-238`), and recovery (`compact_recovery.py:128-202`) compute the same things with different code: candidate listing (`compact_txn.py:196-223` vs `compact_rebuild.py:59-84` vs `compact.py:176-225`), which uuids are sources (`compact_txn.py:633-637` filter added after bug `privileged-nephelite-colt`; rebuild skipped snapshots from day one at `compact_rebuild.py:76-79`), the snapshot envelope (`compact_txn.py:297-326` vs inline `compact_rebuild.py:164-195`, docstring admits "mirroring"), the retire/rollback rule (`compact_txn.py:329-454`, `compact_recovery.py:128-164`; the rebuild retire loop at `compact_rebuild.py:198-205` has no rollback — bug `compulsory-pernickety-mantis`), the two-arm "needs folding" rule (`compact.py:228-283` vs `compact_trigger.py:118-147`), and the commit step (`compact_txn.py:401-415`, `compact_rebuild.py:88-103`, `compact.py:314-350`). Open story `plush-excessive-willet` (snapshot as derived cache) is a design change that this planner makes cheaper; it does not overlap.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py`: `list_candidates(ticket_dir) -> list[Candidate]`, `needs_folding(candidates, threshold, horizon, now)`, `source_uuids_of(candidates)` (the SNAPSHOT-exclusion rule in one place), `build_snapshot_event(...)`, `retire_or_rollback(...)` / `restore_retired(...)`, `commit_ticket_dir(git, ticket_id, message)`. The three paths consume it; rebuild gains rollback for free. Crash-safety mechanisms (intent journal, `.bak`, in-process abort) are unchanged — fsck remains the sole owner of mixed state per `compact_recovery.py:22-26`. Guard: the `*.retired` rename-back rule and the snapshot envelope builder exist once.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py` (new), `compact_txn.py`, `compact_rebuild.py`, `compact_recovery.py`, `compact.py`, `compact_trigger.py`, `tests/unit/commands/test_compact_plan.py` (new). `_compact_locked` and `compact_all_cli` sit at their C901 ceilings, so edits there are subtractive only.

## Testing
Happy path: normal and rebuild over the same ticket directory produce snapshot events with identical `source_event_uuids`. Edge: rebuild interrupted after the first rename rolls back. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_compact_crash_atomicity.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_process_death.py` (real SIGKILL at the rename barrier), `tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py`, `tests/unit/test_creation_channel_compaction.py`, `tests/unit/test_compact_rebuild_counter_b2bb.py` (`_REBUILD_COUNT` stays in `compact_rebuild`) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Normal and rebuild agree on `source_event_uuids` for every fixture ticket; checked by the new equivalence test.
- [ ] A rebuild killed between two renames leaves the ticket directory restorable and fsck-clean; checked by a SIGKILL test at the existing barrier env var.
- [ ] Pinning suites pass unchanged and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports no `increased`; checked by running both.
